attribution_rules: Reviewer-originated means the finding was first raised by this reviewer in the retained task history. It does not establish that nobody else could or did find it independently.
External findings independently reproduced here remain attributed to their reported originator.
Where first discovery cannot be recovered confidently, origin is marked unresolved and no unique-discovery credit is claimed.
Probe counts describe executed checks, not distinct bugs, code coverage or proof of correctness.
Some execution summaries survive in retained task history rather than standalone stdout artifacts; these are identified explicitly. Nothing was rerun to prepare this ledger.
No elapsed review time, aggregate unique-detection count, causal skill-effect estimate or counterfactual detection claim is asserted.
